language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hello, I am Tim.

Hello. My name is Ian. I’m on holiday with my family in Scotland. My sister Crissy and I are going for a hike through the Alder Woods to the beach at Loch Ness. Loch Ness is a large freshwater Loch located in the Scottish Highlands.
It is 37 kilometers long and 230 meters deep! Loch Ness is best known for Nessie, the Loch Ness Monster. We're hoping we will see Nessie from the beach!

As we walk along the path through the Alder Woods the sun's rays come through to us in some places but not in others. Did you know light travels in a straight line until it hits something? But then a number of different things can happen.
Let's find out exactly what can happen and why!
Hello, I am Tim.

Hello. My name is Ian. I’m on holiday with my family in Scotland. My sister Crissy and I are going for a hike through the Alder Woods to the beach at Loch Ness. Loch Ness is a large freshwater Loch located in the Scottish Highlands.
It is 37 kilometers long and 230 meters deep! Loch Ness is best known for Nessie, the Loch Ness Monster. We're hoping we will see Nessie from the beach!

As we walk along the path through the Alder Woods the sun's rays come through to us in some places but not in others. Did you know light travels in a straight line until it hits something? But then a number of different things can happen.
Let's find out exactly what can happen and why!
Light is a type of energy. It always travels in a straight line until it hits something. When that happens it reflects off the surface.

The light changes direction. The light can reflect in different ways. It can get bent or blocked or even diffuse in multiple directions. Crissy wants to know how this works. Let's help her find out by matching the drawings of the light rays to each pictures!

We know light reflects off objects that it hits. How well it reflects depends upon how even the surface is. Smooth, shiny surfaces, like mirrors and metals, reflect light well. Dark, dull, and rough objects do not reflect light well. Can you help decide which of these items will reflect light well?

helperSimple.text: Do you think light reflects well from this object? If you think so, click on the green button. Otherwise, click on the red button.
